# Legacy faults copied into V2 suppliers (slices 1–5)

The V2 suppliers migration keeps parity with master, so where legacy behaves badly V2 often copies it on purpose instead of fixing it. This file lists each such fault, one row per fault, de-duplicated across slices, so the faults can be fixed in legacy and V2 together later. The sources are the ralph state dirs (`ralph/v2-suppliers*`, `ralph/v2-supplier-entity`: questions.md, corrections.md, follow-ups.md, edge-cases.md, REPORT*.md, slice-5 `notes/legacy-map.md`) and the four `parity.yaml` files in `worktrees/v2-supplier-entity/frontend/src/v2/features/`. Left out: faults V2 fixed (deliberate differences), V2-only bugs, and the legacy holes already fixed on `adi/fix/supplier-legacy-holes` (listed at the end). Legacy paths are relative to the repo root on master. Line numbers are the ones the loops recorded and may have drifted. Where a source gave only a function name, the table gives the function name. Slice refs: S1 = `v2-suppliers`, S2–S5 = `v2-suppliers-slice2..5`. Qn = that slice's questions.md question, answered in its corrections.md.
